GREG, 2026-11-07 about 06:50Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #550, message d4c01258), verbatim: „Zadnych nowych warunków”. Asistant's scope: this covers ALL of Unified EO. No new credit conditions, extra blocks, exceptions or non-agreed requirements during implementation, integration or review. Deliver the previously agreed simple scope, remove any non-agreed blockers found, and complete code and tests before heavy validation. Record it and pass it to the implementers.
Agreed scope: credit = host-observed run of the declared command as the turn's first tool action (option B) + declared result artifact valid as the verdict + full source_id before == after (dirty allowed) + the existing item/claim/root/store identity checks. Nothing else. Companion rules: rules-greg-no-credit-blocking-rules-2026-11-07, rules-greg-code-whole-feature-then-heavy-tests-2026-11-07, rules-greg-eo-credit-source-id-equality-2026-11-06, rules-fable-no-unasked-conditions-2026-11-06.
FOR REVIEWERS: a review finding that would ADD a condition to credit is out of scope unless it fixes a real defect in the agreed rule; raise it with the coordinator, not as a blocker.
